stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025): 2,723 applied (817 men, 1,906 women), 2,578 admitted (94.7%), 1,057 enrolled. The 2025-26 Common Data Set does not report the in-state / out-of-state / international split; the 2023-24 Common Data Set (fall 2023) reported 15 international first-year applicants, 15 admitted and 12 enrolled (all applicants 3,189, admitted 2,985, enrolled 1,031). Undergraduate enrollment is 7,501 and the nonresident count is 145 ('Total Undergraduates' figures). SAT/ACT percentile ranges come from IPEDS (fall 2024) because the Common Data Set percentile table is misaligned in the PDF text. GPA bands are the 'all enrolled students' column (the 0.10% below 1.0 is omitted); the Common Data Set average is 3.40. The checkbox sections of the Common Data Set (admission factors, test policy, aid to nonresident students) are not readable as text, so factors are omitted.
